subject: [PATCH 02/12] mm/khugepaged: count collapses where khugepaged makes them

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: LGTM, meaning the reviewer approved of the patch without any issues or concerns.
reviews.raw_body:
On Fri Sep 4, 2026 at 11:10 AM EDT, Kiryl Shutsemau wrote:
> From: "Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta)" <kas@kernel.org>
>
> collapse_single_pmd() bumps khugepaged_pages_collapsed for its caller, and
> tests cc->is_khugepaged to know whether it should: the counter belongs to
> the daemon, and MADV_COLLAPSE must not touch it.
>
> The daemon sees every result of every collapse it asks for, so it can keep
> its own counter without the shared path testing who called.
>
> Assisted-by: Claude-Code:claude-opus-5
> Signed-off-by: Kiryl Shutsemau (Meta) <kas@kernel.org>
> ---
>  mm/khugepaged.c | 11 ++++-------
>  1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)
>
LGTM.

Reviewed-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>


-- 
Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-09-04.patch_summary: This patch series refactors the khugepaged code to improve its functionality and performance. Specifically, it addresses an issue where the khugepaged daemon's page collapse counter is not being updated correctly when the daemon performs a collapse operation.

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the khugepaged functionality in the Linux kernel by addressing issues related to page collapsing and counting. Specifically, it focuses on fixing a bug where khugepaged incorrectly increments its internal counter when collapsing pages.
